card.name: Patient-population words in dosing instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words and the word patient in dosing sentences, such as "patients with", "treatment of" and "in a patient", right before a condition or co-medication is named.

modes.label: with after patients
modes.description: The word with after patients, just before a condition or impairment is named.
modes.example: If patients<< with>> diabetic gastroparesis have severe nausea

modes.label: of after treatment
modes.description: The word of after treatment, just before a psychiatric condition is named.
modes.example: for the treatment<< of>> schizophrenia and the acute treatment of manic or

modes.label: patient before already taking
modes.description: The word patient in a sentence about starting a drug in someone already on another drug.
modes.example: If an opioid analgesic is initiated in a<< patient>> already taking a benzodiazepine

card.writes: It suppresses words for drugs and chemicals, so the next word is more likely a condition or patient detail than a drug class.
card.plain: It fires on the small words that lead into a patient's condition in dosing advice, not on drug names.
